title: Deliver Fruit to Saningpool Food Processing Plant
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Fruit** delivered to **Saningpool Food Processing Plant** (industry id 3, near tile 103,28).

A likely supplier is **Saningpool Fruit Plantation** (industry id 6, near tile 77,24); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **290 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
